text:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike in agent/tool invocations causing sustained queue growth on ded-gpu-pool-7. Error rate up 18% and tail latency > SLA. Auto-shed fired for a subset of tenants. Please triage.
ana (oncall): seeing thousands/minute of external agent.invoke requests with heavy structured payloads. KV cache pressure high, OOM logs on 7/9 pods.
mike s.: reassigning traffic now. I'm going to put an emergency rate cap on agent.invoke for non-enterprise tiers and disable structured payload parsing for 30m.
rachel: +1. can you also throttle function-call retries? most of the surge looks like aggressive client retries.
mike s.: doing both. hitting admin API now. run: ```
# temporary mitigation
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/v1/traffic/control 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" 
  -d '{"action":"set_rate_limit","route":"/agent.invoke","limit_per_minute":2000,"scope":"non-enterprise"}'
```
nana (oncall): posting a short incident note in #incidents and pinging support to prep customer comms.
sean: ops-bot please disable structured-output-mode on hosted clusters except for enterprise-flagged customers.
ops-bot: action queued: disable_structured_output scope=hosted non_enterprise; ETA 45s. :gear:
vikram: confirm we also flip the retry-backoff policy? clients are retrying with no exponential backoff.
mike s.: yes flipping to conservative backoff for all tiers: ```
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/v1/traffic/config 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" 
  -d '{"param":"client_retry_policy","value":"exp_backoff_100ms_max_10s"}'
```
rachel: I see ops-bot committed the structured-output toggle. pods recovering, queue length dropping. tail latency down ~40% after 90s.
nana (oncall): recording mitigation steps in this thread. We should plan a canary rollback path to re-enable structured output for a small whitelisted tenant set once stable.
sean: agreed. mike, can you add a small traffic ramp for the enterprise tier only (50rpm) to validate correctness?
mike s.: ramping enterprise structured-output to 50rpm now. If no errors in 5m we'll try 200rpm.
nana (oncall): handoff: I'm leaving in 15. @rachel you take primary for the next 2h; I'll stay available via DM. Please continue to coordinate with support for customer impact.
rachel: got it. creating a short runbook in this thread for postmortem: list of actions, admin API calls, affected pools, tenant list, and timing.
ops-bot: NOTE: mitigation actions executed: set_rate_limit(/agent.invoke,non-enterprise)=2000/min; disable_structured_output(hosted,non-enterprise)=true; set(client_retry_policy)=exp_backoff_100ms_max_10s; ramp_enterprise_structured_output=50rpm.
sean: ETA to full restore depends on upstream client fixes; recommend keeping structured-output disabled for 1 hour then reassess with metrics. :hourglass:
nana (oncall): supporting notes for SRE-runbook: include the curl commands above, kubectl pod restart pattern, and a Grafana dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/agents/agent-invoke.
mike s.: prepping short status page update. support, please use canned message: "We've temporarily limited advanced agent/function features for some customers to protect latency and availability; we're working to restore full functionality ASAP."
rachel: thanks. I'll start collecting logs and error traces for postmortem. adding this thread to the incident ticket IT-4532.
nana (oncall): marking thread as handed off. keep updates here. :white_check_mark:
